pages.ld_description:
The Dreamworks How to Train Your Dragon Mini Plush Dragon range lets fans take flight with their favourite dragons! Unlock the blind Viking totem to unbox one of five possible styles - Toothless, the Deadly Nadder, the Monstrous Nightmare, the Gronckle and the Terrible Terror (each sold separately). These adorable dragon stuffed toys feature movie-accurate details, coming together as soft plush with shiny scales, felt claws and wings, and expressive embroidered eyes. They also feature adorably short arms, plump bodies, and long tails that keep them standing upright and balanced for display in any collection.

Kids can recreate their favourite scenes or invent new stories as they dive into pretend play with this engaging dragon plush. Explore more thrilling adventures with action figures, playsets, figurines and plush toys in the How To Train Your Dragon range (each sold separately). 

FEATURES:
Inspired by the dragon characters seen in the How To Train Your Dragon film
Unwrap the totem packaging to find one of 5 possible mini plush (each sold separately)
Each plush has shiny scales and embroidered facial features
Recreate scenes from the film or imagine new adventures
Part of the How To Train Your Dragon range, collect them all (each sold separately)
Contents: 1x mystery dragon mini plush
Dimensions: 7.6H cm
